lines.t: Lord, I come with an uncovered heart
No defense left, no place to hide
I called Your silence proof You were gone
While You were standing by my side
I carried questions like stones in my hands
Let them cut the trust I knew
Forgive the nights I turned away
Forgive the doubt that wounded You
I have wandered through my own fear
Still Your mercy found me here
Lord, heal the place I cannot reach
Wash this bitterness out of me
For every wound I keep replaying
Teach my heart to set them free
Take the anger, take the blame
Make me gentle in Your name
I believed the lie that love was lost
Come fill my heart, Lord, with Your love
They left their words beneath my skin
I built a room for every scar
I said I forgave, then held the key
To every memory in the dark
But You were broken for the broken
You know the weight I cannot bear
So I lay down the names and moments
And trust them to Your faithful care
I have trembled at the unknown
Still You call this heart Your home
Lord, heal the place I cannot reach
Wash this bitterness out of me
For every wound I keep replaying
Teach my heart to set them free
Take the anger, take the blame
Make me gentle in Your name
I believed the lie that love was lost
Come fill my heart, Lord, with Your love
I release the hands that hurt me
Not because the pain was small
I release them to Your justice
I release myself from it all
Where resentment made a prison
Let compassion breathe again
Where I doubted You were near me
Let Your presence enter in
Lord, heal the place I cannot reach
Wash this bitterness out of me
For every wound I keep replaying
Teach my heart to set them free
Take the anger, take the blame
Make me gentle in Your name
I surrender every guarded part
Come fill my heart, Lord, with Your love
I am sorry, Lord, I doubted
I am weary, but I come
With these ashes, with this longing
Make my wounded heart Your home
Come fill my heart
Come fill my heart
With Your love
